snippet.title: Tattoo Shop Simulator - Official Launch Trailer | OUT NOW on Steam (-20% OFF!)
snippet.description:
Tattoo Shop Simulator is OUT NOW on Steam! 💉 Grab the game now with a limited-time 20% launch discount!

👉 GET IT ON STEAM: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4236450/Tattoo_Shop_Simulator/

Open your own tattoo studio, expand your workspace, create unique designs, satisfy eccentric clients, and build your tattoo empire from scratch. Can you handle the needle and run a successful business?

🔥 KEY FEATURES:
• Realistic tattooing mechanics and custom designs
• Shop customization, upgrades, and studio management
• Diverse clients with unique demands and reactions
• Expand your brand and build your reputation

Don't forget to like, subscribe, and add the game to your Steam library! Leave a review on Steam to help us grow.

#TattooShopSimulator #IndieGame #Gaming #Trailer #Simulation #Steam #OutNow
